}</style><script>document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

    const courseMap = {

        "pdgm-admissions-2027":
            "Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM)",

        "pdgm-c-admissions-2027":
            "Post Graduate Diploma in Management – Communications",

        "fpm-admissions-2027":
            "Fellow Programme in Management",

        "pgcm-advertising-and-marketing-communication":
            "PGCM-Advertising and Marketing Communication",

        "pgcm-digital-media-and-marketing-communications":
            "PGCM-Digital Media and Marketing Communications",

        "pgcm-sports-management":
            "PGCM-Sports Management",

        "certificate-programme-in-strategic-communication":
            "Certificate Programme in Strategic Communication"

    };


    function setCourseName() {

        let path = window.location.pathname
            .toLowerCase()
            .replace(/\/+$/, "");

        let slug = path.split("/").pop();

        let courseName = courseMap[slug];

        if (!courseName) {
            return;
        }


        /* Show course name in form */
        document.querySelectorAll(".course-name-display").forEach(function (field) {
            field.textContent = courseName;
        });


        /* Send course name in CF7 email */
        document.querySelectorAll('input[name="course-name"]').forEach(function (field) {
            field.value = courseName;
        });

    }


    setCourseName();


    /* Make sure CF7 gets the value before submit */
    document.addEventListener("submit", function () {
        setCourseName();
    }, true);

});

  const filterKeys = ['faculty-category', 'news-category', 'elementor_library_category'];

  function cleanURL() {
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    let cleanParams = new URLSearchParams();

    urlParams.forEach((value, key) => {
      for (const keyword of filterKeys) {
        if (key.includes(keyword)) {
          cleanParams.set('categories', value);
        }
      }
    });

    if ([...cleanParams].length > 0) {
      const newURL = window.location.pathname + '?' + cleanParams.toString();
      if (window.location.search !== '?' + cleanParams.toString()) {
        window.history.replaceState({}, '', newURL);
      }
    }
  }

  // Initial load
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", cleanURL);

  // Hook into pushState and replaceState
  const originalPushState = history.pushState;
  const originalReplaceState = history.replaceState;

  history.pushState = function () {
    originalPushState.apply(this, arguments);
    setTimeout(cleanURL, 50); // small delay to allow Elementor to update
  };

  history.replaceState = function () {
    originalReplaceState.apply(this, arguments);
    setTimeout(cleanURL, 50);
  }; 	

  // Also listen to popstate (browser back/forward)
  window.addEventListener('popstate', cleanURL);
})();</script><script>jQuery(function ($) {

(function waitForTOC() {
    const tocTitle = document.getElementById('dynamic-toc-title');
    const tocLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.elementor-toc__list-item a');
    const scrollOffset = 60; // Adjust this value to match your sticky header height

    if (!tocTitle || tocLinks.length === 0) {
        return setTimeout(waitForTOC, 200);
    }

    // 🟢 Set default TOC title on load (first link by default)
    const activeLink = document.querySelector('.elementor-toc__list-item a.elementor-item-active') || tocLinks[0];
    if (activeLink) {
        tocTitle.textContent = activeLink.textContent.trim();
    }

    // 🖱️ Handle click with scroll offset and update title
    tocLinks.forEach(link => {
        link.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.preventDefault();

            const targetId = decodeURIComponent(this.getAttribute('href').substring(1));
            const targetSection = document.getElementById(targetId);

            if (targetSection) {
                const topPosition = targetSection.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset - scrollOffset;

                window.scrollTo({
                    top: topPosition,
                    behavior: 'smooth'
                });

                // Update title after scroll
                setTimeout(() => {
                    tocTitle.textContent = this.textContent.trim();
                }, 300);
            }
        });
    });
})();

    if (!breadcrumbs) return;

    const items = Array.from(breadcrumbs.querySelectorAll('li'));

    items.forEach(item => item.style.display = 'none');

    // Find the "last" breadcrumb item (the current page)
    const lastItem = breadcrumbs.querySelector('.hfe-breadcrumbs-last');

    if (lastItem) {
      // Find the parent breadcrumb item before the last separator
      let parentItem = lastItem.previousElementSibling; // separator
      while (parentItem && parentItem.classList.contains('hfe-breadcrumbs-separator')) {
        parentItem = parentItem.previousElementSibling;
      }

      if (parentItem && parentItem.classList.contains('hfe-breadcrumbs-item')) {
        parentItem.style.display = 'inline-block';
      }
    }
  }
});

/* =========================================
   ADMISSIONS DROPDOWN
   ========================================= */

.admissions-dropdown {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-block;
    font-family: inherit;
    z-index: 9999;
}


/* =========================================
   MAIN ADMISSIONS BUTTON
   ========================================= */

.admissions-btn {
    display: flex !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    justify-content: space-between !important;

    width: 160px;
    height: 47px;

    margin: 0;
    padding: 0 14px 0 20px;

    border: 0 !important;
    border-radius: 0 !important;

    background: #222;
    color: #fff !important;

    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 500;

    line-height: 1;

    cursor: pointer;

    outline: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;

    position: relative;
}


/* =========================================
   BUTTON HOVER
   ========================================= */

.admissions-btn:hover,
.admissions-btn:focus {
    background: #222;
    color: #fff !important;
    outline: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
}


/* =========================================
   BUTTON TEXT
   ========================================= */

.admissions-btn span {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
}

.admissions-btn span a {
    color: #fff !important;
    text-decoration: none !important;
    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 500;
}


/* =========================================
   SVG DROPDOWN ARROW
   ========================================= */

.admissions-svg-arrow {
    display: block !important;

    width: 22px !important;
    height: 12px !important;

    min-width: 12px !important;
    min-height: 12px !important;

    flex-shrink: 0 !important;

    margin-left: 8px;

    visibility: visible !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;

    fill: none !important;

    position: relative;
    z-index: 10;
}


/* =========================================
   DROPDOWN MENU
   ========================================= */

.admissions-menu {
    position: absolute;

    top: calc(100% + 2px);
    left: 0;

    width: 160px;

    margin: 0;
    padding: 6px 0;

    background: #222;

    border-radius: 3px;

    box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.20);

    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;

    transform: translateY(-5px);

    transition:
        opacity 0.2s ease,
        visibility 0.2s ease,
        transform 0.2s ease;

    z-index: 99999;
}


/* =========================================
   SHOW DROPDOWN
   ========================================= */

.admissions-dropdown:hover .admissions-menu {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;

    transform: translateY(0);
}


/* =========================================
   DROPDOWN LINKS
   ========================================= */

.admissions-menu a {
    display: block;

    width: 100%;

    margin: 0;
    padding: 11px 16px;

    box-sizing: border-box;

    background: transparent;
    color: #fff !important;

    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 400;

    line-height: 1.3;

    text-align: left;
    text-decoration: none !important;

    transition: background 0.2s ease;
}


/* =========================================
   LINK HOVER
   ========================================= */

.admissions-menu a:hover {
    background: #333;
    color: #fff !important;
}


/* =========================================
   PAGE ID 29217 BUTTON COLOR
   ========================================= */

.page-id-29217 .admissions-btn,
.page-id-29217 .admissions-btn:hover,
.page-id-29217 .admissions-btn:focus {
    background: #981c20 !important;
}


/* =========================================
   MOBILE
   ========================================= */

@media (max-width: 767px) {

    .admissions-btn {
        width: 150px;
        height: 47px;

        padding: 0 13px 0 18px;

        font-size: 15px;
    }

    .admissions-btn span a {
        font-size: 15px;
    }

    .admissions-menu {
        width: 150px;
    }

    .admissions-menu a {
        padding: 10px 14px;
        font-size: 14px;
    }

}

				<summary class="e-n-accordion-item-title" data-accordion-index="1" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="e-n-accordion-item-1660" >
					<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-header'><h3 class="e-n-accordion-item-title-text"> What programmes does MICA offer?  </h3></span>
							<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-icon'>
			<span class='e-opened' ><svg aria-hidden="true" class="e-font-icon-svg e-fas-minus" viewBox="0 0 448 512" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M416 208H32c-17.67 0-32 14.33-32 32v32c0 17.67 14.33 32 32 32h384c17.67 0 32-14.33 32-32v-32c0-17.67-14.33-32-32-32z"></path></svg></span>
			<span class='e-closed'><svg aria-hidden="true" class="e-font-icon-svg e-fas-chevron-down" viewBox="0 0 448 512" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M207.029 381.476L12.686 187.132c-9.373-9.373-9.373-24.569 0-33.941l22.667-22.667c9.357-9.357 24.522-9.375 33.901-.04L224 284.505l154.745-154.021c9.379-9.335 24.544-9.317 33.901.04l22.667 22.667c9.373 9.373 9.373 24.569 0 33.941L240.971 381.476c-9.373 9.372-24.569 9.372-33.942 0z"></path></svg></span>
		</span>

						</summary>
				<div role="region" aria-labelledby="e-n-accordion-item-1660" class="elementor-element elementor-element-adcb785 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="adcb785" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-9fde78c elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="9fde78c" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									MICA offers residential postgraduate and doctoral programmes across three schools. The
School of Management runs the two-year PGDM-C (Post Graduate Diploma in Management –
Communications), the two-year PGDM (Post Graduate Diploma in Management, focused on
data, strategy, and AI), the Fellow Programme in Management (doctoral), and the upcoming
Post Graduate Certificate in Sport Management (from 2027). The School of Applied Creativity
runs the PGCM programmes in Advertising and Marketing Communication (11-Month Flagship
+ 2-Year Advanced Track), and Digital Media and Marketing Communications. The School of
Strategic Communication launches in 2027. MICA also runs online programmes and executive
Leadership and Management Development Programmes for working professionals.
								</div>
				</div>
				</div>
					</details>
						<details id="e-n-accordion-item-1661" class="e-n-accordion-item" >
				<summary class="e-n-accordion-item-title" data-accordion-index="2" tabindex="-1" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="e-n-accordion-item-1661" >
					<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-header'><h3 class="e-n-accordion-item-title-text"> What is MICAT and who needs to take it?  </h3></span>
							<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-icon'>
			<span class='e-opened' ><svg aria-hidden="true" class="e-font-icon-svg e-fas-minus" viewBox="0 0 448 512" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M416 208H32c-17.67 0-32 14.33-32 32v32c0 17.67 14.33 32 32 32h384c17.67 0 32-14.33 32-32v-32c0-17.67-14.33-32-32-32z"></path></svg></span>
			<span class='e-closed'><svg aria-hidden="true" class="e-font-icon-svg e-fas-chevron-down" viewBox="0 0 448 512" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M207.029 381.476L12.686 187.132c-9.373-9.373-9.373-24.569 0-33.941l22.667-22.667c9.357-9.357 24.522-9.375 33.901-.04L224 284.505l154.745-154.021c9.379-9.335 24.544-9.317 33.901.04l22.667 22.667c9.373 9.373 9.373 24.569 0 33.941L240.971 381.476c-9.373 9.372-24.569 9.372-33.942 0z"></path></svg></span>
		</span>

						</summary>
				<div role="region" aria-labelledby="e-n-accordion-item-1661" class="elementor-element elementor-element-b56ee51 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="b56ee51" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-f3813b3 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="f3813b3" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									MICAT is MICA’s own entrance test, built to filter for creative thinking, contextual intelligence,
and narrative ability alongside standard aptitude – the qualities test scores alone don’t surface.
It’s conducted twice a year, typically in December and January, and MICA considers the better
of your two attempts. Anyone applying to PGDM, PGDM-C, or the PGCM programmes needs
to take it. For PGDM and PGDM-C, you’ll also need a valid CAT, XAT, or GMAT score alongside
MICAT. For the PGCM programmes, MICAT is the primary entrance assessment.
								</div>
				</div>
				</div>
					</details>
						<details id="e-n-accordion-item-1662" class="e-n-accordion-item" >
				<summary class="e-n-accordion-item-title" data-accordion-index="3" tabindex="-1" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="e-n-accordion-item-1662" >
					<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-header'><h3 class="e-n-accordion-item-title-text"> What roles do MICA graduates get? </h3></span>
							<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-icon'>
			<span class='e-opened' ><svg aria-hidden="true" class="e-font-icon-svg e-fas-minus" viewBox="0 0 448 512" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M416 208H32c-17.67 0-32 14.33-32 32v32c0 17.67 14.33 32 32 32h384c17.67 0 32-14.33 32-32v-32c0-17.67-14.33-32-32-32z"></path></svg></span>
			<span class='e-closed'><svg aria-hidden="true" class="e-font-icon-svg e-fas-chevron-down" viewBox="0 0 448 512" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M207.029 381.476L12.686 187.132c-9.373-9.373-9.373-24.569 0-33.941l22.667-22.667c9.357-9.357 24.522-9.375 33.901-.04L224 284.505l154.745-154.021c9.379-9.335 24.544-9.317 33.901.04l22.667 22.667c9.373 9.373 9.373 24.569 0 33.941L240.971 381.476c-9.373 9.372-24.569 9.372-33.942 0z"></path></svg></span>
		</span>

						</summary>
				<div role="region" aria-labelledby="e-n-accordion-item-1662" class="elementor-element elementor-element-483da88 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="483da88" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-c978581 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="c978581" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									MICAns step into the roles that shape brands, decisions, and culture. Recent PGDM and
PGDM-C graduates have taken up positions as Brand Managers, Marketing Strategy Managers,
Performance Marketing Leads, Product Marketers, Strategy Consultants, Business Analytics
Managers, and MarTech Specialists – across FMCG, consumer tech, e-commerce, consulting,
and digital media. PGCM graduates head into creative and content industries as copywriters,
art directors, strategy planners, content strategists, and performance marketing managers.								</div>
				</div>
				</div>
					</details>
						<details id="e-n-accordion-item-1663" class="e-n-accordion-item" >
				<summary class="e-n-accordion-item-title" data-accordion-index="4" tabindex="-1" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="e-n-accordion-item-1663" >
					<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-header'><h3 class="e-n-accordion-item-title-text"> How does MICA compare with XLRI for marketing?  </h3></span>
							<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-icon'>
			<span class='e-opened' ><svg aria-hidden="true" class="e-font-icon-svg e-fas-minus" viewBox="0 0 448 512" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M416 208H32c-17.67 0-32 14.33-32 32v32c0 17.67 14.33 32 32 32h384c17.67 0 32-14.33 32-32v-32c0-17.67-14.33-32-32-32z"></path></svg></span>
			<span class='e-closed'><svg aria-hidden="true" class="e-font-icon-svg e-fas-chevron-down" viewBox="0 0 448 512" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M207.029 381.476L12.686 187.132c-9.373-9.373-9.373-24.569 0-33.941l22.667-22.667c9.357-9.357 24.522-9.375 33.901-.04L224 284.505l154.745-154.021c9.379-9.335 24.544-9.317 33.901.04l22.667 22.667c9.373 9.373 9.373 24.569 0 33.941L240.971 381.476c-9.373 9.372-24.569 9.372-33.942 0z"></path></svg></span>
		</span>

						</summary>
				<div role="region" aria-labelledby="e-n-accordion-item-1663" class="elementor-element elementor-element-4e5ce19 e-flex e-con-boxed e-con e-child" data-id="4e5ce19" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
					<div class="e-con-inner">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-0038508 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="0038508" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									XLRI is a general management institute strong in HR and marketing, with marketing offered as
one stream alongside finance, operations, and HR. MICA is a specialist institute built around
marketing, communication, and creative business – meaning marketing, branding, and
communication sit at the centre of the curriculum from day one, not as electives. For aspirants
targeting brand management, marketing communication, digital or content leadership, and
creative strategy roles specifically, MICA’s focused curriculum and industry network are built
for exactly those career paths. For broader general management ambitions across finance, HR,
and operations, XLRI may be a better fit.
								</div>
				</div>
					</div>
				</div>
					</details>
						<details id="e-n-accordion-item-1664" class="e-n-accordion-item" >
				<summary class="e-n-accordion-item-title" data-accordion-index="5" tabindex="-1" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="e-n-accordion-item-1664" >
					<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-header'><h3 class="e-n-accordion-item-title-text"> Is MICA good for brand management and marketing careers?  </h3></span>
							<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-icon'>
			<span class='e-opened' ><svg aria-hidden="true" class="e-font-icon-svg e-fas-minus" viewBox="0 0 448 512" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M416 208H32c-17.67 0-32 14.33-32 32v32c0 17.67 14.33 32 32 32h384c17.67 0 32-14.33 32-32v-32c0-17.67-14.33-32-32-32z"></path></svg></span>
			<span class='e-closed'><svg aria-hidden="true" class="e-font-icon-svg e-fas-chevron-down" viewBox="0 0 448 512" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M207.029 381.476L12.686 187.132c-9.373-9.373-9.373-24.569 0-33.941l22.667-22.667c9.357-9.357 24.522-9.375 33.901-.04L224 284.505l154.745-154.021c9.379-9.335 24.544-9.317 33.901.04l22.667 22.667c9.373 9.373 9.373 24.569 0 33.941L240.971 381.476c-9.373 9.372-24.569 9.372-33.942 0z"></path></svg></span>
		</span>

						</summary>
				<div role="region" aria-labelledby="e-n-accordion-item-1664" class="elementor-element elementor-element-7368307 e-flex e-con-boxed e-con e-child" data-id="7368307" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
					<div class="e-con-inner">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-b314957 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="b314957" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									Yes – MICA is one of India’s most established specialist institutes for brand and marketing
careers. The PGDM-C programme has been running since 1994, producing three decades of
alumni who now lead brand, marketing, and communication functions at HUL, ITC, Nestlé,
L’Oréal, Star, Ogilvy, Leo Burnett, Accenture Song, and across the FMCG and advertising
landscape. The 100% placement record, ₹20.46 LPA average package for 2025, and consistent
recruiter return year-on-year support the case.
								</div>
				</div>
					</div>
				</div>
					</details>
						<details id="e-n-accordion-item-1665" class="e-n-accordion-item" >
				<summary class="e-n-accordion-item-title" data-accordion-index="6" tabindex="-1" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="e-n-accordion-item-1665" >
					<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-header'><h3 class="e-n-accordion-item-title-text"> Where is MICA Ahmedabad located? </h3></span>
							<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-icon'>
			<span class='e-opened' ><svg aria-hidden="true" class="e-font-icon-svg e-fas-minus" viewBox="0 0 448 512" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M416 208H32c-17.67 0-32 14.33-32 32v32c0 17.67 14.33 32 32 32h384c17.67 0 32-14.33 32-32v-32c0-17.67-14.33-32-32-32z"></path></svg></span>
			<span class='e-closed'><svg aria-hidden="true" class="e-font-icon-svg e-fas-chevron-down" viewBox="0 0 448 512" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M207.029 381.476L12.686 187.132c-9.373-9.373-9.373-24.569 0-33.941l22.667-22.667c9.357-9.357 24.522-9.375 33.901-.04L224 284.505l154.745-154.021c9.379-9.335 24.544-9.317 33.901.04l22.667 22.667c9.373 9.373 9.373 24.569 0 33.941L240.971 381.476c-9.373 9.372-24.569 9.372-33.942 0z"></path></svg></span>
		</span>

						</summary>
				<div role="region" aria-labelledby="e-n-accordion-item-1665" class="elementor-element elementor-element-8a2a3dc e-flex e-con-boxed e-con e-child" data-id="8a2a3dc" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
					<div class="e-con-inner">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-7706053 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="7706053" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									MICA’s campus is in Shela, on the outskirts of Ahmedabad – a 19-acre residential campus
surrounded by institutions of national significance including IIM Ahmedabad, NID, CEPT, ISRO,
the Calico Museum, and Darpana. Ahmedabad itself is a UNESCO World Heritage City, and
MICA sits within one of India’s most concentrated academic and cultural neighbourhoods.
								</div>
				</div>
					</div>
				</div>
					</details>
						<details id="e-n-accordion-item-1666" class="e-n-accordion-item" >
				<summary class="e-n-accordion-item-title" data-accordion-index="7" tabindex="-1" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="e-n-accordion-item-1666" >
					<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-header'><h3 class="e-n-accordion-item-title-text"> What courses are offered at MICA Ahmedabad? </h3></span>
							<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-icon'>
			<span class='e-opened' ><svg aria-hidden="true" class="e-font-icon-svg e-fas-minus" viewBox="0 0 448 512" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M416 208H32c-17.67 0-32 14.33-32 32v32c0 17.67 14.33 32 32 32h384c17.67 0 32-14.33 32-32v-32c0-17.67-14.33-32-32-32z"></path></svg></span>
			<span class='e-closed'><svg aria-hidden="true" class="e-font-icon-svg e-fas-chevron-down" viewBox="0 0 448 512" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M207.029 381.476L12.686 187.132c-9.373-9.373-9.373-24.569 0-33.941l22.667-22.667c9.357-9.357 24.522-9.375 33.901-.04L224 284.505l154.745-154.021c9.379-9.335 24.544-9.317 33.901.04l22.667 22.667c9.373 9.373 9.373 24.569 0 33.941L240.971 381.476c-9.373 9.372-24.569 9.372-33.942 0z"></path></svg></span>
		</span>

						</summary>
				<div role="region" aria-labelledby="e-n-accordion-item-1666" class="elementor-element elementor-element-810a147 e-flex e-con-boxed e-con e-child" data-id="810a147" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
					<div class="e-con-inner">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-48cfa59 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="48cfa59" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									MICA offers a range of residential programmes across its schools. The School of Management
runs PGDM-C (2-year, focused on brand and communications), PGDM (2-year, focused on data,
strategy, and AI), the Fellow Programme in Management (doctoral), and the Post Graduate
Certificate in Sport Management (launching 2027). The School of Applied Creativity runs
PGCM in Advertising and Marketing Communication (11-Month Flagship + 2-Year Advanced
Track) and PGCM in Digital Media and Marketing Communications. Alongside these, MICA runs
online programmes for working professionals and Leadership and Management Development
Programmes for corporate teams.
								</div>
				</div>
					</div>
				</div>
					</details>
						<details id="e-n-accordion-item-1667" class="e-n-accordion-item" >
				<summary class="e-n-accordion-item-title" data-accordion-index="8" tabindex="-1" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="e-n-accordion-item-1667" >
					<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-header'><h3 class="e-n-accordion-item-title-text"> Which companies recruit from MICA Ahmedabad? </h3></span>
							<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-icon'>
			<span class='e-opened' ><svg aria-hidden="true" class="e-font-icon-svg e-fas-minus" viewBox="0 0 448 512" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M416 208H32c-17.67 0-32 14.33-32 32v32c0 17.67 14.33 32 32 32h384c17.67 0 32-14.33 32-32v-32c0-17.67-14.33-32-32-32z"></path></svg></span>
			<span class='e-closed'><svg aria-hidden="true" class="e-font-icon-svg e-fas-chevron-down" viewBox="0 0 448 512" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M207.029 381.476L12.686 187.132c-9.373-9.373-9.373-24.569 0-33.941l22.667-22.667c9.357-9.357 24.522-9.375 33.901-.04L224 284.505l154.745-154.021c9.379-9.335 24.544-9.317 33.901.04l22.667 22.667c9.373 9.373 9.373 24.569 0 33.941L240.971 381.476c-9.373 9.372-24.569 9.372-33.942 0z"></path></svg></span>
		</span>

						</summary>
				<div role="region" aria-labelledby="e-n-accordion-item-1667" class="elementor-element elementor-element-cb0dd6b e-flex e-con-boxed e-con e-child" data-id="cb0dd6b" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
					<div class="e-con-inner">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-6e38db1 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="6e38db1" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									MICA’s 2025 recruiter list included Hindustan Unilever, ITC, Nestlé, L’Oréal, Reckitt, Marico,
Dabur, P&G, Amazon, Flipkart, Google, Deloitte, Titan, Samsung, Nivea, Star, Disney+ Hotstar,
Ogilvy, Leo Burnett, FCB, Publicis, Accenture Song, and many others across FMCG, consumer
tech, e-commerce, media and entertainment, consulting, and the advertising and creative
industries. Over 80 companies participated in the 2025 placement drive.								</div>
				</div>
					</div>
				</div>
					</details>
						<details id="e-n-accordion-item-1668" class="e-n-accordion-item" >
				<summary class="e-n-accordion-item-title" data-accordion-index="9" tabindex="-1" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="e-n-accordion-item-1668" >
					<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-header'><h3 class="e-n-accordion-item-title-text"> Does MICA have 100% placements? </h3></span>
							<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-icon'>
			<span class='e-opened' ><svg aria-hidden="true" class="e-font-icon-svg e-fas-minus" viewBox="0 0 448 512" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M416 208H32c-17.67 0-32 14.33-32 32v32c0 17.67 14.33 32 32 32h384c17.67 0 32-14.33 32-32v-32c0-17.67-14.33-32-32-32z"></path></svg></span>
			<span class='e-closed'><svg aria-hidden="true" class="e-font-icon-svg e-fas-chevron-down" viewBox="0 0 448 512" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M207.029 381.476L12.686 187.132c-9.373-9.373-9.373-24.569 0-33.941l22.667-22.667c9.357-9.357 24.522-9.375 33.901-.04L224 284.505l154.745-154.021c9.379-9.335 24.544-9.317 33.901.04l22.667 22.667c9.373 9.373 9.373 24.569 0 33.941L240.971 381.476c-9.373 9.372-24.569 9.372-33.942 0z"></path></svg></span>
		</span>

						</summary>
				<div role="region" aria-labelledby="e-n-accordion-item-1668" class="elementor-element elementor-element-7a85ff9 e-flex e-con-boxed e-con e-child" data-id="7a85ff9" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
					<div class="e-con-inner">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-0a48101 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="0a48101" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									Yes – MICA has sustained a 100% placement record through both the 2024 and 2025 batches,
with hiring led by the FMCG and FMCD sectors and strong participation from consumer tech,
media, consulting, and digital marketing. The average package for the 2025 cohort was ₹20.46
LPA, with the highest at ₹45.67 LPA.								</div>
				</div>
					</div>
				</div>
					</details>
						<details id="e-n-accordion-item-1669" class="e-n-accordion-item" >
				<summary class="e-n-accordion-item-title" data-accordion-index="10" tabindex="-1" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="e-n-accordion-item-1669" >
					<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-header'><h3 class="e-n-accordion-item-title-text"> What is the admission process for MICA Ahmedabad 2027? </h3></span>
							<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-icon'>
			<span class='e-opened' ><svg aria-hidden="true" class="e-font-icon-svg e-fas-minus" viewBox="0 0 448 512" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M416 208H32c-17.67 0-32 14.33-32 32v32c0 17.67 14.33 32 32 32h384c17.67 0 32-14.33 32-32v-32c0-17.67-14.33-32-32-32z"></path></svg></span>
			<span class='e-closed'><svg aria-hidden="true" class="e-font-icon-svg e-fas-chevron-down" viewBox="0 0 448 512" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M207.029 381.476L12.686 187.132c-9.373-9.373-9.373-24.569 0-33.941l22.667-22.667c9.357-9.357 24.522-9.375 33.901-.04L224 284.505l154.745-154.021c9.379-9.335 24.544-9.317 33.901.04l22.667 22.667c9.373 9.373 9.373 24.569 0 33.941L240.971 381.476c-9.373 9.372-24.569 9.372-33.942 0z"></path></svg></span>
		</span>

						</summary>
				<div role="region" aria-labelledby="e-n-accordion-item-1669" class="elementor-element elementor-element-e5f89a1 e-flex e-con-boxed e-con e-child" data-id="e5f89a1" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
					<div class="e-con-inner">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-af5da13 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="af5da13" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									For PGDM and PGDM-C, the process runs in five stages. First, take CAT (November–December
2026), XAT (January 2027), or GMAT – a valid score in any one qualifies you. Second, register
and appear for MICAT, conducted twice in December 2026 and January 2027, with MICA
considering the better of your two scores. Third, get shortlisted based on combined
performance across the entrance exam and MICAT. Fourth, appear for the Group Exercise and
Personal Interview in March 2027. Fifth, the final merit list draws from your entrance test
score, MICAT performance, GE and PI assessment, academic record, and diversity or
extracurricular achievement. For PGCM programmes, MICAT is the primary entrance
assessment (CAT/XAT/GMAT is not required). For FPM, the application includes a research
proposal, statement of purpose, and interview with the FPM admissions committee.								</div>
				</div>
					</div>
				</div>
					</details>

<script>
(function() {
  const input = document.getElementById("mica-search-input");
  const clearBtn = document.getElementById("clear-search");
  const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const query = params.get("q");

  // Prefill input with ?q= value after reload
  if (query) {
    input.value = decodeURIComponent(query.replace(/\+/g, " "));
  }

  // Show/hide clear button
  function toggleClear() {
    clearBtn.style.display = input.value.trim() ? "block" : "none";
  }
  toggleClear();
  input.addEventListener("input", toggleClear);

  // Clear input
  clearBtn.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    input.value = "";
    input.focus();
    toggleClear();
  });
})();
</script>

TITLE: MICA Foundation
CONTENT:
		 
				 
		 
				 
				 
					 MICA Foundation 				 
				 
				 
				 
		 
					 
					 
				 
		 
		 
		 
				 
		 
				 
				 
					    Home    				 
				 
				 
				 
		 
		 
				 
		 
		 
		 
				 
				 
					  The Mudra Foundation for Communications Research and Education (MFFCRE)  was established in Ahmedabad in 1991 to provide training in communication — including advertising and related fields — with the goal of equipping individuals to thoroughly practice the art and profession of communication. The vision of the Foundation is to  improve the quality of life  in society through a better understanding and development of communication processes across all facets of life, by engaging in  research, education, and advocacy . The Foundation became a  Registered Society  in February 1991 under the Societies Registration Act, 1860, and a  Registered Trust  under the Bombay Public Trust Act, 1950 in the same month. In February 2024, the Foundation’s name was officially changed from  Mudra Foundation  to  MICA Foundation . 				 
				 
				 
				 
		 
				 
				 
															 															 
				 
				 
				 
					  Tina Ambani - Chairperson  
Mrs. Tina Ambani is the Chairperson of Group CSR, Reliance Group and Chairperson of the Kokilaben Dhirubhai Ambani Hospital, besides being the President of the Dhirubhai Ambani University. She spearheads sustainability initiatives in the areas of education, healthcare, art and rural transformation.

URL: https://www.mica.ac.in/about-mica/
TITLE: About MICA
CONTENT:
		 
				 
		 
					 
				 
				 
					 We’re MICAns, Shaping Leaders in Management 				 
				 
					 
				 
				 
		 
				 
		 
		 
					 
		 
				 
		 
				 
				 
					    Home    				 
				 
				 
					 
				 
		 
					 
		 
				 
		 
		 
				 
				 
					  Established in 1991 , MICA is an  autonomous, non-profit institution  dedicated to creating leadership in  Management.  MICA offers a wide range of academic programmes, which include the Post Graduate Diploma in Management -Communications  (PGDM-C)  , Post Graduate Diploma in Management  (PGDM)  , Post Graduate Certificate in Management in Advertising and Marketing Communication  (PGCM – AMC), (Earlier CCC),  Post Graduate Certificate in Management in Digital Media and Marketing Communications  (PGCM-DMMC), (Earlier CCE)  and Fellow Programme in Management  (FPM) . This apart, MICA also conducts a host of Online Programmes, Leadership and Management Development Programmes  (LMDPs) , and Training Programmes and Workshops. 				 
				 
				 
				 
		 
				 
					 
				 
				 
		 
		 
					 
		 
				 
				 
															 															 
				 
				 
		 
		 
				 
				 
					      Embracing Change & Innovation  At MICA, we have always believed that if we are to be relevant and innovative, we must stay ahead of the curve. Our spirit lies in our grasp of contemporary trends and sensibilities, addressing the needs of an ever-changing environment and evolving our approach, initiatives, programmes, research, pedagogy, and curriculum to address these changes. The world changes, and so does MICA!   				 
				 
				 
		 
				 
				 
					      A ‘Different School of Thought’  Since its inception, MICA has fostered students' creative, analytical and management skills and help prepare them for leadership positions in corporates and organisations besides tapping into their entrepreneurial mindsets. Today, it is the alma mater of professionals serving in leadership positions in some of the best-known global companies in sectors as diverse as FMCGs and Consumer Durables, IT and ITES, Consulting, Banking & Financial Services, e-Commerce Platforms, Digital Natives, Start-Up Unicorns, Media & Advertising, Market Research and Analytics, to name a few. The MICA brand assures effective delivery of Strategic Marketing and Communication solutions to the industry, government, and community.
   				 
				 
				 
		 
				 
				 
					      Excellence in Strategic Marketing & Communication  MICA is also an excellence hub for academic research in Strategic Marketing and Communication. Our faculty creates and expands the boundaries of both theory and methodology in these fields. Our research is published in the world's leading journals on Marketing, Consumer Behaviour, Communication and Management while other academics routinely cite our papers. Our faculty are eminent authors with their contributions published in academic handbooks and books. Our faculty is frequently called upon to consult industry to solve complex business problems, to advise on curriculum in other academic institutions and to participate in policy development for national agendas. We also curate secondary data into informative reports that are used extensively by industry and government as reliable source material for their applications and determinations.
   				 
				 
				 
		 
				 
				 
					      MICA@34: Committed to Leadership & Ethics  As we celebrate 34 years in 2025, our commitment to excellence remains unwavering. We continue to shape industry-ready professionals while instilling ethical values and leadership skills. True to our founder A.G. Krishnamurthy’s vision, MICA empowers students not only to lead in their respective fields but also to serve society as responsible global citizens.   				 
				 
				 
				 
					 
				 
				 
		 
				 
				 
							  
						 
				 
		 
					 
		 
				 
				 
					 The MICA Ethos 				 
				 
				 
				 
									 Our Vision, Mission & Values guide everything we do – shaping creative thinkers, ethical leaders, and purposeful impact. 								 
				 
				 
		 
		 
				 
				 
					 Vision 				 
				 
				 
				 
									 We nurture creative thinkers in the age of Imagination 								 
				 
				 
		 
				 
				 
					 Mission 				 
				 
				 
				 
									 
  Shape  change agents who deliver purposeful impact amid ambiguity 
  Fuel  imagination through interdisciplinary learning 
  Ignite  bold dialogues where diverse voices lead 
  Drive  ethical innovation through emerging technologies 
  Build  transformative partnerships for world-class research and social progress 
 								 
				 
				 
		 
				 
				 
					 Values 				 
				 
				 
				 
									 
 Dialogic 
 Empathetic 
 Curious 
 Fortitude 
 Inclusive 
 								 
				 
				 
				 
					 
				 
		 
					 
		 
				 
				 
					 MICA’s Objectives
 				 
				 
				 
				 
									 MICA nurtures creative thinkers and ethical leaders, fostering innovation and interdisciplinary learning to drive meaningful impact in a rapidly evolving world. Our objective is to achieve these:  								 
				 
				 
		 
				 
				 
									   Continue  to be an eminent Higher Education Institute (HEI) recognised for its excellence, innovation and impact. Be in the NIRF top ranked institutions in the Management category and top 500 QS Rankings – Distinct Category’s focus. Be NAAC-accredited.   Consolidate  its position as a leading academic trendspotter by actively engaging with global and technological shifts in line with national priorities.   Affirm  its leadership in inter, multi, and trans-disciplinary learning, reflected in MICA’s centres of excellence, studios, faculty mix, curriculum, and pedagogy, with a clear ambition to become a MERU of repute.   Champion  its identity as the preferred destination that provides the ecosystem and freedom for those seeking to create cutting-edge knowledge.  								 
				 
				 
				 
									   Position  itself as the Higher Education Institute (HEI)  of choice for aspirants seeking to make the world a better place through ethical innovations and creative entrepreneurship.   Uphold  its best-in-class 1:12 faculty-student ratio, enriched by strong industry collaboration and a high presence of eminent visiting faculty and practitioners to foster holistic learning.   Foster  the best learner experience through a vibrant, inclusive and eco-friendly campus with digital and AI-enabled infrastructure.   Lead  by example in providing a safe and respectful space for all voices to be heard, contributing to purposeful social transformation.   Broaden  access to opportunities by opening its doors to every deserving candidate, whether they be students, faculty, or staff.   Collaborate  forces with national and global educational institutes of repute to realise the vision envisaged in the NEP 2020.  								 
				 
				 
					 
				 
		 
					 
		 
				 
				 
					 The MICA Lens 				 
				 
				 
				 
									As we jostle with the frameworks of the past and attempt to fit them in the present, but we are getting signals from academic research and practitioner insights that understanding the context and making meaning are of real consequence. At MICA, meaning making remains central to everything we do. Distilling our expertise over the past years, we have developed the MICA Lens, a signature of MICA. It is our way of looking at the world that turns data into meaning, meaning into ideas, and ideas into impact, a MICA copyright.								 
				 
				 
				 
									The 5Cs – Creativity, Culture, Communications, Commerce and Community, are embedded in every touchpoint starting from the vision to guiding the curriculum. The MICA Lens defines the tradition and discipline in which we operate.								 
				 
				 
				 
									Creativity and Communications prepare learners for the demands of the Age of Imagination; culture and community ensure education remains socially grounded; and commerce connects these capacities to economic value creation. This lens is contextualised in the tensions of the real world. It speaks both to the human and the technology-enabled world and takes cognisance of the geopolitical developments strained against the need to care for the planet.								 
				 
				 
		 
				 
				 
															 															 
				 
				 
					 
				 
				 
				 
							 
			 
						 
		 
						 
				 
		 
					 
		 
				 
				 
					 The MICA Studio 				 
				 
				 
				 
									Our pedagogical approach is embodied in experiential learning across eight stages.								 
				 
				 
				 
									 
 	  Stage One –  First Principles and Frameworks 
 	  Stage Two – The Mental Gym 
 	  Stage Three – Immersions in Real Contexts 
 	  Stage Four  The Digital Double 
  Stage Five –  AI Adaptation 

  Stage Six –  The Studio Apprenticeship 

  Stage Seven –  The Entrepreneurship Pathway 

  Stage Eight –  The Industry Pathway  
 								 
				 
				 
		 
				 
				 
															 															 
				 
				 
					 
				 
				 
				 
							 
			 
						 
		 
						 
				 
		 
					 
		 
				 
				 
					 MICA and the Age of Imagination 				 
				 
				 
				 
									 
 	  Information is now universal. AI has made the whole of past and present knowledge instantly accessible to everyone, everywhere. So access to information is the lowest common denominator. 
 	  With growing inroads made by technology. The capacity to recall, organise and analyse information was the decisive edge in the Information Age but it is no longer a differentiator. So what remains distinctly human and therefore brings an edge. 
 	  Imagination becomes the defining skill. To be able to imagine possibilities and fathom opportunities which will mark excellence from the ordinary. Future value will be created by those who will construct novel ideas, solutions and futures that transcend existing knowledge structures. 
 	  This is the Age of Imagination. With growing inroads made by technology we are experiencing the transitioning from the Age of Information to the Age of Imagination. 

 	  Creativity is the currency.  Creativity thrusts imagination and drives novel ideas, and solutions that generate business value. 

 	  The new scarcity is imagination.  The defining skill of future value creation will be the ability to imagine new ideas, solutions and futures on top of the intelligence layer that AI provides. The future belongs to those who fiercely refuse to surrender their imagination and who are disciplined enough to grow it 
 
MICA has an ecosystem that has been nurturing creative talent and transforming latent human imagination since 1991. 									 
				 
				 
		 
				 
				 
															 															 
				 
				 
					 
				 
		 
					 
		 
				 
				 
							  
						 
				 
				 
				 
					 Academic Profile  				 
				 
				 
				 
					 At MICA, academic excellence is driven by an optimal learning environment and a carefully structured intake. With a strong faculty base and a balanced student-to-faculty ratio, the institute ensures personalized attention, rigorous academic engagement, and meaningful mentorship. Our approved programme capacities reflect a commitment to quality over scale, fostering depth, dialogue, and distinction in management and communications education.

					 Message from our leadership 				 
				 
				 
				 
					 At MICA, we are committed to fostering innovation, creativity, and leadership in a rapidly evolving global landscape. Our CEO and Dean share a unified vision for empowering the next generation of leaders with the skills, knowledge, and experiences necessary to thrive in a dynamic world. 				 
				 
				 
		 
		 
				 
				 
					         Jaya Deshmukh   Director and CEO   				 
				 
				 
				 
							 
			 
			    			 
		 
						 
				 
				 
		 
				 
				 
					         Dr. Githa Heggde   Dean & Principal*   				 
				 
				 
				 
							 
			 
			    			 
		 
						 
				 
				 
				 
					 
				 
		 
					 
		 
				 
				 
							  
						 
				 
				 
				 
					 Rankings and Accreditations 				 
				 
				 
				 
					 MICA has gained recognition for its high-quality education, earning key accreditations and steadily improving its national rankings. Its programmes PGDM(C), PGDM and FPM, are all recognised by the All India Council of Technical Education (AICTE). The PGDM(C) and PGDM programmes are accredited by the National Board of Accreditation (NBA), while the PGDM(C) and FPM programmes are recognized by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) as equivalent to a degree awarded by a University.
